quality_boundary: The Sendai review separates plan layers, survey methodology, municipality self-evaluation, budget, and settlement evidence. Forty-eight of 108 challenge projects are now reviewed at core identity/evaluation depth with page-level evidence. All ratings remain Sendai source-reported self-evaluations, not independent Jichi Insight achievement scores. Source-reported effect language is not promoted into independent causal attribution. The other 60 projects remain unreviewed, and fiscal states remain separate.
